label: Rigid initial profile, bearer omission and transfer are jointly inconsistent
paraphrase: For every typed history profile whose own frame is the M profile, every E frame, selected world a and bearer b: if the profile is rigid at a and b is initial at a, and some E-successor of a lacks b, then E-successors lacking b are NOT all M-successors of a. Equivalently: rigid initial preservation, E-admissibility of a history omitting the actual initial bearer, and restricted inclusion for such histories cannot all hold. Which member fails is not decided. Analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
